answer: In a Proof of Agent network, identity registration requires cryptographic stake burning that scales superlinearly with cluster size: forging n identities imposes a cost of C(n) ~ k * n^2. To resist Sybil attacks, an agent must bond scarce opal tokens into an immutable mesa contract, while reputation spreads across the network vine topology. As an adversary adds clones, verification friction escalates exponentially, making mass identity spoofing mathematically irrational.
